body:
## Pull request overview

This PR upgrades `POST /api/v1/ai/chat` and the `service-ai` streaming stack to support the Vercel AI Data Stream Protocol so it can be consumed directly by `@ai-sdk/react/useChat` (default streaming), while retaining a legacy JSON response mode via `stream: false`.

**Changes:**
- Added a Vercel Data Stream encoder (`encodeStreamPart`, `encodeVercelDataStream`) and exports for it.
- Introduced `VercelLLMAdapter` using Vercel AI SDK (`generateText`/`streamText`) and exported it publicly.
- Updated `/api/v1/ai/chat` to accept both legacy `{ messages, options }` and Vercel-style flat request fields, defaulting to streaming with a `vercelDataStream` response flag.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 9 out of 9 changed files in this pull request and generated 4 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/services/service-ai/src/stream/vercel-stream-encoder.ts | Implements Vercel Data Stream Protocol frame encoding for `TextStreamPart` events. |
| packages/services/service-ai/src/stream/index.ts | Re-exports stream encoder utilities. |
| packages/services/service-ai/src/routes/ai-routes.ts | Adds `vercelDataStream` response flag, relaxes message validation to accept array content, and makes `/chat` dual-mode (stream default, JSON when `stream:false`). |
| packages/services/service-ai/src/index.ts | Public exports for `VercelLLMAdapter` and stream encoder utilities. |
| packages/services/service-ai/src/adapters/vercel-adapter.ts | Adds a production adapter backed by Vercel AI SDK. |
| packages/services/service-ai/src/adapters/index.ts | Re-exports the new adapter and its config type. |
| packages/services/service-ai/src/__tests__/vercel-stream-encoder.test.ts | Adds unit tests for all encoded frame types and stream transformation behavior. |
| packages/services/service-ai/src/__tests__/ai-service.test.ts | Updates/extends route tests for dual-mode behavior and new input formats. |
| CHANGELOG.md | Documents the protocol/migration changes and new adapter/encoder. |
</details>

`systemPrompt` is read from `body.system ?? body.systemPrompt` and cast to `string | undefined` without runtime validation. If a client sends a non-string value here, it will be inserted into `finalMessages` as `content` and may cause downstream adapter/provider errors. Recommend validating that `system`/`systemPrompt` is a string when present (otherwise return 400).

`VercelLLMAdapter.chat()` forwards only `temperature` and `maxTokens` from `AIRequestOptions`. Other supported request options (notably `stop`, and tool-calling related fields like `tools`/`toolChoice` used by `AIService.chatWithTools`) are currently ignored, which will prevent those features from working when this adapter is used in production. Please plumb through the remaining relevant options (and/or explicitly document that this adapter does not support tool definitions).

`VercelLLMAdapter.streamChat()` also ignores most of `AIRequestOptions` (e.g. `stop`, and tool-calling related fields like `tools`/`toolChoice`). If streaming is meant to be feature-parity with `chat()`, the adapter should forward the same option set to `streamText()`; otherwise it should clearly error/guard when unsupported options are provided to avoid silent misconfiguration.
